fusions.name: Halter Hold
fusions.desc: Takes hold of one enemy within 3 tiles and deals 10 damage, taking its next action away for 3 seconds and knocking it back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Leg Up
fusions.desc: A driving kick at a target up to 4 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full range. On a hit, every ally strikes 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Under Load
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Calm Before the Leap
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 12 seconds.
